newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Rouble firm, funds needed to pay taxes, buy T-bills.
newsitem.headline: Rouble firm, funds needed to pay taxes, buy T-bills.

text.p: The rouble was steady on Friday on consistent demand from major Russian enterprises for tax payment purposes and on non-resident buying for investment in government securities, dealers said.
roubles/dollar Apr 25 midday Apr 25 early Apr 24 close
An Interbank Finance House dealer said some major banks had bought huge rouble credits, after which rates edged down, but that the market was sticking to around the 20 percent level.
Dealers said gas monopoly Gazprom had been seen buying roubles quite actively over the last few days.

"Non-residents are seeking roubles as well to buy T-bills," one dealer said. "Besides, some funds could be needed for wage payments. Banks prefer to sell dollars today rather than rouble credits ahead of the weekend."
